home.heroTitle: Piping systems engineered for every drop of India's growth.
home.heroSubtitle: Poddar Pipes designs and manufactures uPVC, CPVC, SWR, TANKS, UGD, and Agriculture piping systems for households, farms, industries, and infrastructure projects across India.
home.heroSlide_growth_desc: Poddar Pipes designs and manufactures uPVC, CPVC, SWR, UGD and agricultural piping systems, as well as water storage tanks, for households, farms, industries and infrastructure projects across India.
home.overviewTitle: A 50-year legacy of excellence in plumbing.
home.overviewDesc: Since 1975, the Poddar name has been part of India’s piping industry, beginning in Patna and expanding to Bengaluru in 1998.
home.overviewDesc2: Driven by a commitment to quality, innovation and market needs, Poddar has built expertise in CPVC and PVC piping solutions, with a deep understanding of the people who build and maintain our infrastructure — from engineers and contractors to dealers and, above all, plumbers.
home.overviewFacilityCaption: One production standard, engineered to Indian Standards — every batch, every plant.
home.whyTitle: Built on standards, not just capacity.
home.whyDesc: We treat every product line as an engineering problem first — that discipline shows up in how our systems perform years after installation.
home.whyBisDesc: Our uPVC, CPVC, SWR, and UGD ranges are manufactured to the relevant Indian Standards, with in-house batch testing for pressure, impact, and thermal performance before every dispatch.
home.whyWallDesc: Precision extrusion holds tolerance across every diameter we manufacture.
home.whyDealersDesc: Spanning every major state in India.
home.whySupportDesc: Technical guidance for large plumbing and infrastructure projects.
home.whyResponseDesc: Every dealer or technical enquiry, answered within a business day.
home.whySustainDesc: Reclaimed material streams reduce virgin resin use across our extrusion lines — without compromising pressure ratings.
home.categoriesTitle: Six product categories. One manufacturing standard.
home.categoriesDesc: From agricultural mains to hospital plumbing risers, every Poddar Pipes product line shares the same testing rigour and is designed to the relevant Indian Standard.

home.categoriesCpvcDesc: Reliable performance for hot and cold water.

home.mfgStep1Desc: Automated lines hold wall-thickness tolerance across every diameter we make.

faq.heading: Your questions,
faq.desc: Can't find what you're looking for? Send us a message and a team member will follow up directly.
faq.q0: What is the difference between CPVC and uPVC pipes?
faq.a0: CPVC is designed for hot and cold water plumbing, while uPVC is used for cold water supply. The right choice depends on the water temperature, operating pressure and application.
faq.q1: How do SWR and UGD piping systems differ?
faq.a1: SWR systems carry soil, waste and rainwater from buildings. UGD systems carry drainage underground towards sewer networks. They serve different parts of a drainage system and should be selected for their intended application.
faq.q2: Which Poddar products are designed for drinking water use?
faq.a2: Our CPVC and uPVC plumbing ranges are designed for drinking water supply, while our tanks use food-grade plastic for water storage. Each range has different operating requirements, so check its intended use before selecting.
faq.q3: How does Poddar Pipes check the quality of its products?
faq.a3: Our quality checks cover incoming raw materials, production and finished products. These include dimensional checks, laboratory testing for every batch and regular testing through independent laboratories to help maintain consistent product quality.
faq.q4: How can I express interest in becoming a partner?
faq.a4: Complete the ‘Become a Partner’ form with your company details, business type, location and coverage area. You can also tell us about your experience and interests so our team can understand your business.
faq.q5: Can I enquire about products for a planned project?
faq.a5: Yes. Use the contact form to tell us about your project, its location and the application you have in mind. Include any product questions or requirements you would like to discuss with our team.
